title: An absolutely magical and...
text:
An absolutely magical and unforgettable experience. Walking through the narrow streets of the Albaicín and Granada's viewpoints takes on a whole new dimension when the history and architecture are explained through the rhythm and passion of flamenco.

The guide masterfully connected the city's most iconic landmarks with the roots, legends, and soul of this art form, giving every single corner its own unique 'duende'.
